paragraphs: Friend, here is the big idea. When God warns, He means it, and the warning is a gift. The horn blows, the signal flag goes up, and the people are told, "Seek refuge! Do not delay!" (Jeremiah 4:6). Nobody gets a snooze button on this one, and I would know, because I have hit it a lot.

Now look at WHY the warning comes. The LORD says, "Your ways and deeds have brought this upon you" (Jeremiah 4:18). The people had rebelled against Him, and they had been told, "You will have peace," while a sword was at their throats (Jeremiah 4:10, 4:17). A comfortable lie is a scary thing to build your life on, friend. I think the kindest voice in the room is the one that tells you the truth while there is still time to hear it.

And right in the middle of the alarm, there is a door left open: "Wash the evil from your heart, O Jerusalem, so that you may be saved" (Jeremiah 4:14). Even when the LORD says, "I will not finish its destruction," the call to come back to Him is still sitting there (Jeremiah 4:27). So here is what I want you to carry out of my bakery, baker. Take God's warnings seriously, let Him clean your heart, and run to Him instead of away from Him. His Word is still the safest place to stand.
